parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records — `SecretsResponse` in `Shared/MusicShareKit/Tests/MusicShareKitTests/AuthNetworkClientE2ETests.swift` — carries `is_test: true`, which is a restraint marker that dominates any action signal. The cluster therefore represents a deliberate test-local type alias that mirrors the shape of the production `AppSecrets` type alias in `AppServices/AppConfiguration.swift`. Lifting or merging these would couple production `AppServices` semantics to test infrastructure in `MusicShareKit`, which is the canonical anti-pattern the restraint rule is designed to prevent. No refactor is warranted.
